title: Semantic Authority Expansion
goal: Extend authority resolution from file/target-level lookup into semantic claim and domain authority mapping.

problem.current_state: Authority resolution can identify governing sources for explicit targets, but it does not yet resolve which authority governs a semantic claim, concept, operator, theorem, domain rule, or runtime decision.
problem.gap: Agents still need to infer semantic authority from documents manually instead of querying the DB runtime.
problem.risk: Patches can appear structurally valid while relying on the wrong semantic authority.

objectives: Add semantic authority records to the governance runtime DB.
Map concepts, claims, operators, domains, and patch types to governing authority sources.
Extend the authority command to accept semantic queries.
Allow patch-gate to consult semantic authority when a patch declares affected concepts or claims.
Return allow/block/defer decisions with explicit semantic authority rationale.

schema_additions.purpose: Maps semantic targets to authoritative governance sources.

columns.semantic_type: claim | concept | operator | theorem | domain | patch_type | runtime_rule
columns.authority_source: registry/document/db record that governs the target

schema_additions.purpose: Append-only history of semantic authority changes.

patch_gate.new_behavior: If patch metadata declares semantic_targets, patch-gate resolves semantic authorities and reports mismatches, missing authorities, or superseded authorities.

context_capsule.new_behavior: Include a compact semantic authority summary for the requested target when available.

initial_semantic_targets.canonical_expression: Registry remains canonical authority; DB runtime is operational projection.
Database provides executable governance and runtime decision support.

acceptance_criteria: authority command can resolve both target/file authority and semantic authority.
patch-gate reports semantic authority status for patches with semantic_targets.
context-capsule can include compact semantic authority entries.
Missing semantic authority produces defer, not silent allow.
Superseded semantic authority produces warning or block according to rank.
Registry remains canonical; DB semantic authority map is projection/runtime support.
non_goals: Do not make the DB canonical.
Do not require every historical patch to declare semantic targets immediately.
Do not implement full claim-evidence graph yet.

expected_result.runtime_maturity: moves from target governance toward meaning-aware governance

warnings: Semantic authority is now queryable through the runtime gate and the context capsule.
